## Population, arms and causal construction

Both arms cover the original 10,747 eligible keys (2,160 / 2,159 / 2,112 / 2,160 / 2,156): 21,494 contrast rows; with the five saved references B0/B1/B2/B3/A1, 75,229 scored rows. Fold 3 has 2,112 hours on 88 represented dates; the peak 408 hours / 17 dates. No denominator changed and no eligible key was dropped. Both arms use the frozen 638 CP-16 fold/date origins, the same 35 training-only admission dates (frozen and committed before outer scoring) and the same genuine warm-up starts. H0 is the no-weather V2-H replayed from identity-verified CP-15/CP-16 component caches; it reproduces the accepted CP-16 V2-H vectors: {'bitwise_equal': True, 'keys_equal': True, 'max_abs_difference': 0.0, 'rows': 10747}. HG refits the identical A1/B2 recipes with only three same-local-hour weather columns appended; selected penalties may differ because inputs differ. Each arm consumes only its own genuinely issued errors under identical release/support/update rules.

Real-data controls (`causal-controls.json`): fold_1 2020-07-01: HG refit reproduction {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}, delivery-day/future mask {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}, available D−1 price mutation {'A1': 437.5844787016467, 'B2': 420.2016505256707}, future weather {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}, available weather {'A1': 6.039613253960852e-14, 'B2': 7.815970093361102e-14}, neutralised weather vs H0 {'A1': 3.552713678800501e-15, 'B2': 0.0}; fold_4 2025-05-01: HG refit reproduction {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}, delivery-day/future mask {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}, available D−1 price mutation {'A1': 517.9248172534185, 'B2': 430.2086549266156}, future weather {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}, available weather {'A1': 1.0658141036401503e-13, 'B2': 4.405364961712621e-13}, neutralised weather vs H0 {'A1': 1.4210854715202004e-14, 'B2': 1.4210854715202004e-14}.

## Weather input (regional proxy, not a DE-LU polygon or generation forecast)

GFS 0.25° operational D−1 00 UTC, 2,476 runs, 123800 target messages decoded and validated ({'aws': 87200, 'ncar': 36600}); payload 103.67 GiB. Missingness classes: {'ok': 59422, 'structural_missing_pre_2019_run': 24}; structural-missing delivery days: ['2019-01-01']; classified missing runs: none. Local-hour cells 59440, missing 24, repeated autumn hours averaged 6. Admission retained raw samples byte-identical: 600/600. The eight added 2023-03-24..31 runs passed the targeted field/lead/availability checks: 8/8. Radiation clipping by version is in `radiation-clipping.csv`.

Disclosed assumptions carried from admission: NCAR-only 2019–2020 field presence was inferred at admission (every CP-20 message was decoded and validated); availability before D−1 11:00 UTC is reconstructed from dated NCEP production-status averages with an assumed, unevidenced dissemination lag, not a per-day delivery guarantee; delivery 2019-01-01 weather is structurally missing; the radiation-precision criterion was defined after admission sampling and v14/v15 DSWRF is packed at 10 (or 1) W m⁻²; AWS lacks 2021-02-02 and NCAR 2024-09-15 f039 is truncated. ICON is not admitted and was not used. Admission does not certify live use.

## Economics and limits

No new economic calculation, optimiser, annualisation or threshold. Historical economics may be cited only with its original population, assumptions and post-selection limits. Inherited A65 vintage/revision assumptions remain limitations. The 2022 crisis fold informs exploratory comparison and cannot become unseen evidence.

## Post-freeze repair r13: available-weather positive control

The frozen "available weather" control above multiplies all available weather by 3.0. The inherited training-only standardisation cancels a uniform rescaling exactly, so its movement (at most 4.4e-13) is floating-point round-off: it is a units/scaling-invariance check, not a positive control. The frozen control and its output are unchanged. Two non-affine positive controls on the same days replace it as evidence (`causal-controls-supplement.json`, pass threshold 1e-06 EUR/MWh):

- fold_1 2020-07-01: target-day D−1 weather shift {'A1': 370.10749609660024, 'B2': 899.6620841374897}; training-weather permutation (seed 15042, 13102 rows) {'A1': 3.53860507168525, 'B2': 5.733107169452282}; base refit vs cached HG {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}.
- fold_4 2025-05-01: target-day D−1 weather shift {'A1': 19141.061707921494, 'B2': 7461.879954872928}; training-weather permutation (seed 15042, 51209 rows) {'A1': 33.526282757148664, 'B2': 23.133850440792344}; base refit vs cached HG {'A1': 0.0, 'B2': 0.0}.

All passed: True. Post-freeze changes are listed in `post-freeze-repairs.json`; rights and attribution for the weather-derived artifacts are in `rights-notice.md`.
